name: Bypass of a required layer that has no package (known miss)
source: Layer bypass with a required_layer the program does not have: the handler reaches the repository and the policy requires a service layer, but no package sits under the service prefix. Known miss, by design: pkg/projectmodel/go_layer_bypass.go treats a required layer with no call-graph node as ambiguous and reports nothing, so that a mistyped prefix cannot remove nothing and flag everything
